title: Large Language Models and Social Media Information Integrity: Opportunities, Challenges, and Research Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature and proposing stratified error analysis to evaluate precision, recall, and false-positive rates in content moderation across different linguistic subgroups, low-resource languages, and dialects.

Analyzing disparities in automated content verification and moderation outcomes across diverse cultural contexts to identify disproportionate impacts and false positives affecting marginalized and non-dominant groups.
